title: The Envoy-flavored 'call it a draw' option to settle a companion quarrel is a real will check that can fail even with a very high bonus, and failure costs regard with BOTH quarreling companions at once (a strictly worse outcome than either partisan option, which only ever costs one side). It failed twice in this run: once at +6 needing 5+ (rolled 3), once at +8 needing 11+ (rolled 2). The 'diplomatic' path is billed as the peacemaking option but is mechanically the highest-variance, double-downside one.
where: The Empty Seat (barrow-doors quarrel between Brother Osk and Tamsin) and Wynne's Record-House (Wardmoor; Vell/Tamsin quarrel over the fort's founding)
